column1: FM noise signal of required band width generated by Noise Generation Module along with
DTO is used as LO signal to generate the spot noise technique at victim radar frequency.
As the same DTO is used for down/up conversion process, the tuning frequency error of
DTO is automatically compensated, avoiding additional hardware for AFC correction. The
Automatic frequency correction of jammer signal frequency is not required for barrage
technique as the jamming signal bandwidth is large compared to the tuning frequency error
of the DTO. During barrage noise jamming, the DTO is directly tuned to radar frequency
covering 6-18 GHz and the band width varies from 60 MHz to 400 MHz covering the
frequency range of agile radar/multiple radars to be encountered.
